public_rationale: The condition has not been established by comparable revenue evidence. The readable market research measures infrastructure spending, and broader spending sources could not be verified through read_page. This does not show that the market remained below the threshold. Because the antecedent is unknown, the conditional forecast cannot currently be scored. No deadline or decisive event closes its horizon.
limitations: The search does not establish a comprehensive worldwide revenue total.
Unknown accounting basis prevents a definitive monetary comparison.
Even reaching the threshold would not alone prove that a new kind of AI was necessary.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Reaching a trillion-dollar AI market will require a new, reliable and trustworthy kind of AI beyond GenAI.

statement.excerpt: But unlocking that market will require something new: a different kind of AI that is reliable and trustworthy.
statement.document_title: GenAI’s day of reckoning may have come

our_interpretation: The condition is that the worldwide AI market reaches at least US$1 trillion in realized revenue over a year.
The context makes this a necessity claim about an approach beyond GenAI, not merely a prediction that existing generative models will improve.
A trillion dollars of investment, infrastructure spending, valuation, cumulative sales, or annualized run rate does not automatically establish the condition.
Support requires evidence that the different approach was necessary; its presence alongside a trillion-dollar market would not alone prove necessity.
No deadline is supplied. The rule for an unverified conditional antecedent takes precedence over the general unresolved outcome for open-ended forecasts.
criteria.support_condition: The annual revenue condition is established, and technical and commercial evidence shows that reaching it depended on a new, reliable and trustworthy approach beyond GenAI.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The annual revenue condition is established through existing AI approaches, including GenAI, without requiring the proposed new kind of AI.
